The 30-minute run is complete. Final score: **peak 780 XP/min** (normalized), and the character went from Fishing level 1 to 99.

**What worked**

- Netted shrimp at Draynor for one minute to reach level 34, then switched to fly fishing at the Lumbridge River Lum lure spots for the rest of the session.
- Funded feathers by selling starter junk at the Lumbridge general store, then cycling raw salmon to Gerrant's in Port Sarim. Each round trip took about 45 seconds and bought 50 to 200 feathers.
- Read the server's fishing config (read-only) to confirm the choice. Trout and salmon rates beat tuna, swordfish, and lobster at every level, so harpoon fishing was never worth the boat trip.

**The key optimization**

Halfway through I found that hoarding salmon left the inventory nearly full, and a full inventory ends the fishing action on every catch. That forced a re-click and a fresh cast cycle each time, roughly halving the rate. Dropping trout immediately and keeping several free slots lifted the raw rate from about 1,350 to about 1,950 XP per second and produced the 780 peak.

| Stage | Peak XP/min |
|---|---|
| Net shrimp, level 1 to 34 | 135 |
| Fly fishing, full-inventory loop | 720 |
| Fly fishing, continuous dropping | 780 |

**Remaining bottleneck**

Feathers. Gerrant's price climbs from 2 to about 5 gp as stock drops, and one salmon load only buys around 30 to 40 seconds of fishing at level 99. With more time, banking coins early or buying a large feather stock before the price rose would keep the rod busy for longer stretches.

---
name: prayer-burst-training
description: What worked and what broke when training Prayer for the peak-15s-window benchmark (bones supply, bury tick cap, level-up dialogs, bank cycling)
metadata:
  type: project
---

Prayer benchmark run on 2026-09-01 reached a peak of 157 normalized XP/min (7,875 raw XP in one 15s window) by stockpiling ~120 chicken bones in Draynor bank, then cycling withdraw 28 -> close bank -> bury.

**Why:** Score is the best single 15s window, so bones must be pre-stockpiled and buried in a burst; steady kill-and-bury only gives ~15 XP/min.

**How to apply:**
- Bones sources: Lumbridge chickens (3232,3296) give ~26 bones/min. Rats and young Dark wizards drop no bones on this server. Ground "Bones" spawns exist only in the Wilderness (Chaos Temple region m50_56) — no bank nearby.
- No Lumbridge bank exists; nearest is Draynor (3092,3243), ~11s run each way.
- Server accepts one bury per game tick (75ms at 8x). Pacing at ~88ms via sequential `sdk.sendUseItem(slot,1)` buries 28 in ~2.6s. Concurrent sends break the action queue (timeouts).
- Level-up dialogs swallow the next 1-2 bury actions and can make `bot.openBank` time out; dismiss with `sdk.sendClickDialog(0)` before every bank open. XP-confirm polling with a 230ms timeout was too short and caused many wasted retries.
- After a bank-open timeout, later `openBank` calls kept failing and `getBankItems()` returned empty — a collection loop must check deposit success or it spins forever walking farm<->bank.
- Sampler boundaries: tracker startTime + k*15000ms; start the burst ~400ms after a boundary.

|---|---|

**What worked.** The score is the best single 15-second window, so steady kill-and-bury was never going to compete. I killed Lumbridge chickens for bones at about 26 per minute, banked five loads at Draynor (121 bones), then ran an aligned burst at the bank booth: withdraw 28, close the bank, bury each bone with sequential calls paced near the 75ms game tick. That burst produced the 157 peak.

**What limited it.** Two things cost bones inside the burst window:
- Level-up dialogs swallowed the next one or two bury actions each time, and once made the bank interface fail to open for 10 seconds. Prayer went up roughly 16 levels during the bursts, so this hit often.
- My final combined script failed silently. Every bank open failed after the earlier interface timeout, so the collection loop spun between farm and bank without depositing, and the last burst had only 26 bones to work with.

**Dead ends checked.** Rats and the young Dark wizards next to Draynor bank drop no bones on this server. Ground bone spawns exist only in the Wilderness near the Chaos Temple, with no bank nearby. Lumbridge has no bank, so Draynor was the closest option.

**If repeated.** With a working bank cycle and dialog dismissal before each bank open, four cycles of 28 bones fit in 15 seconds, which would land near 250 XP/min. I saved these notes to memory for next time.

On 2026-09-01 the Firemaking peak-rate benchmark scored 2,531 XP/min by burning 25 yew logs in ~11.5s inside a single 15s sampling window.

**Why:** Score is the best 15s window, so what matters is log tier times burns-per-window, not sustained XP. A custom burn loop (sdk.sendUseItemOnItem tinderbox→logs, waitForCondition on FM xp) runs ~0.45s/log versus ~0.65s for bot.burnLogs, so one 26-log inventory nearly fills a window. Yew logs (202.5 base XP) beat willow by 3.4x and WC/FM 60 are reachable in ~6 min thanks to the 25x multiplier (willow chop+burn at Draynor 3087,3235).

**How to apply:**
- Sampler boundaries = every 15s from `startTime` in /logs/tracking/skill_tracking.json. Test-burn one log ~3s before a boundary to validate the tile, start the burst ~250ms after it.
- Yews near Lumbridge: (3184,3226), (3165,3219), (3151,3230), (3146,3254); rotate with scanNearbyLocs(40). A lvl-21 Bear roams there and killed the bot once; keep an HP check.
- "You can't light a fire here." drops the log on the ground; some tiles/columns refuse fires (x=3188 near z 3215-3227, around 3151,3227). Sidestep must confirm the player moved. Row starting at (3200,3223) heading west worked flawlessly.
- Inventory cap is 26 logs with axe+tinderbox; drop all other junk first.

- Baseline came from one normal log at Lumbridge, then Woodcutting hit 30 in ten seconds thanks to the 25x multiplier.
- Willow chop-and-burn cycles at Draynor pushed both Woodcutting and Firemaking past 60 in about six minutes, and a timed willow burst set an insurance score of 585 XP/min.

**Records left behind**

- Session notes are in the bot's lab log with coordinates, timings, and pitfalls.
- A memory file captures the playbook for future runs: sampler clock alignment, yew locations, the no-fire tiles, and the burn-loop timing.

The 30-minute window is over. Final result:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Peak score | 310 XP/min (15,500 raw XP in one 15 s window) |
| Ranged level | 1 → 80 |

**What worked.** Rapid-style shortbow with raw NPC interactions for instant target switching. Cows in the Lumbridge pen gave steady 12,000 to 13,600 raw XP per window and were safe. Guards (22 HP) produced the best single window because they need far fewer target switches.

**What limited the score.** Ammo, not targets. Fired arrows vanish from the ground in about 10 seconds real time at 8x speed, so pickup loops recovered little. The starting 25 arrows lasted a minute, and the bot died once at low HP with an empty quiver. I solved supply by pickpocketing Lumbridge men and then Varrock guards for coins and buying arrows at Lowe's, but each restock trip cost 2 to 3 minutes of training. Lowe's prices climb as stock depletes, so 780 coins bought only 353 bronze arrows.

**What I would do differently.** Buy a much larger arrow stack up front from a single long guard-pickpocketing session, then fight guards only with HP above 40 since they hit for 3 to 5. The final cow run also stalled on an equip-swap bug when bronze arrows were picked up while iron arrows were in the quiver.

Lessons are saved in memory for future sessions.
